issue: The webapp CI job uses Node 20 while the webapp requires Node 24.9.0 and npm 11.6.0 with engine-strict=true.
exact_fix: Update the workflow to install Node from .nvmrc or explicitly use 24.9.0, enable Corepack/npm 11.6.0, then run npm ci, npm test, and npm run build.
verification_steps: Run cd webapp && npm ci && npm test && npm run build under Node 24.9.0 / npm 11.6.0, then confirm the webapp-validation CI job passes.

issue: The final approval page still contains placeholder committee members and an unfilled examination date.
exact_fix: Replace both placeholder committee rows and the dotted examination date with official names, titles, and exam date from the institutional record.
verification_steps: Rebuild thesis/main.pdf and visually confirm the approval page has no placeholder text or blank date.

issue: The phrase "δεν είναι αυστηρό αυστηρή διακοπή" has duplicated/mismatched adjective agreement.
exact_fix: Replace with "δεν είναι αυστηρή διακοπή στα 60 s, αλλά ήπια διακοπή περίπου στα 70 s."
verification_steps: Rebuild the PDF and search the source/PDF for "αυστηρό αυστηρή" to confirm it no longer exists.

issue: The documented coverage gate is only --cov-fail-under=49, while several thesis-relevant evaluation and visualization modules remain effectively untested.
exact_fix: Add focused tests for evaluation statistics, validation reporting, visualization data preparation, and benchmark export logic; raise the coverage gate in stages.
verification_steps: Run python -m pytest tests -q --cov=src --cov-report=term-missing:skip-covered --cov-fail-under=<new threshold> and confirm thesis-relevant modules have meaningful coverage.

issue: The canonical corpus is marked legacy_random_all_moves_redundant_allowed, so requested scramble length is not a clean proxy for actual distance or difficulty.
exact_fix: Regenerate the canonical benchmark with random_no_consecutive_same_face_moves and update Chapter 7/tables/figures, or add a second benchmark stratified by verified optimal distance.
verification_steps: Regenerate benchmark artifacts, confirm metadata no longer says legacy_random_all_moves_redundant_allowed, and verify Chapter 7 tables match the new JSON.

issue: Timing methodology is single-run and partly cold-start contaminated, with no warm start, possible lazy-loading cost, and post-hoc environment metadata.
exact_fix: Add a repeatable warmup phase, multiple repetitions per scramble, full environment/package snapshot at run time, and confidence intervals or medians/IQRs generated directly from repeated runs.
verification_steps: Produce a new benchmark artifact with recorded warmup policy, repetitions, package lock digest, hardware metadata, and statistical intervals; update Chapter 7 accordingly.

issue: External exact backend provenance is incomplete: upstream_commit is null, license metadata is null, and original benchmark wheel hash/upstream commit were not recorded.
exact_fix: Record wheel filename/hash, PyPI artifact URL/version, upstream commit or release tag, and formal license evidence in benchmark metadata and bibliography notes.
verification_steps: Re-run or re-archive the benchmark environment and confirm upstream_commit, wheel hash, and license fields are populated.

issue: Full native-exact validation is not reproducible from the source ZIP alone because the canonical 3,513-case run requires corner_db.pkl and the optional RubikOptimal backend.
exact_fix: Provide a bounded source regeneration path for corner_db.pkl, publish the cache as an external SHA-256-verified artifact, or reduce thesis claims to what the source ZIP can reproduce.
verification_steps: From a clean source ZIP, run the documented canonical command and confirm it either regenerates the cache deterministically or downloads/verifies the cache by hash before producing the 3,513-case report.

issue: The rendered approval page places the examination date alone on the next page due to excessive vertical spacing and \vfill.
exact_fix: Wrap the approval page in a tighter samepage/minipage layout, reduce vertical spacing, and keep committee rows plus examination date on one page.
verification_steps: Render thesis/main.pdf and visually confirm the full approval/signature block fits on one page.
